findings.basis: The two NEW initializers queue native CallbackTarget member pointers without adopting the actual virtual providers. In particular, NEW Tu1140ParameterScene derives only from CallbackTarget, so the second call delivers an unrelated object to a provider that writes TransitionScreenW19G::phase/progress/previous_phase. func_00177b10 stores this pair and the actual 001b7dac trampoline performs the virtual member dispatch; this is not opaque, non-invoking registration. The new code therefore extends the unresolved scene/member-callback contract family instead of remaining independent of it. Recover and migrate the actual common receiver hierarchy, native slot providers and invocation contract together before crediting these initializers; equal pointer widths or another nominal base/cast do not close the contract.
